_law: Every table that carries a USMCA row must appear in exactly one of PURGE / KEEP / KEEP_BANKING. A table that appears in neither is an ERROR, not a default. The generator exits 1 rather than guess. Owner scope: purge all USMCA transaction data, banking excluded.
_measured_live: 2026-09-23 on tiny-field-89581227 / br-fancy-credit-akjnd07a, SET LOCAL app.bypass_rls = 'lucia'

_purge_notes.banking.reconciliation_matches: A match row points a bank transaction at a document this purge deletes. The bank transaction itself is KEPT and is left unmatched. Deleting the match is not deleting bank data.
_purge_notes.banking.reconciliation_drift_alerts: Same reason. An alert about a deleted document is not a bank fact.
_purge_notes.banking.bank_transaction_splits: A split allocates a KEPT bank transaction across documents being deleted. The parent transaction and its amount are untouched.
_purge_notes.accounting.posting_batches: 1,874 rows. Missing from the 2026-09-22 purge SQL entirely. A batch whose postings are gone is an orphan header.
_purge_notes.driver_finance.escrow_balances: 17 rows. Missing from the 2026-09-22 purge SQL. If left, every driver's escrow DOUBLES when the feed re-creates holds.

DOCS_FILES._rule: docs.files is NOT purged wholesale. The 2026-09-22 SQL deleted all 475 USMCA rows; only the app-generated artifacts of purged documents may go. Owner-uploaded source documents are evidence and are KEPT.
DOCS_FILES.purge_predicate: rows whose only linkage is to a purged document (docs.file_links -> a purged parent) AND source <> 'owner_upload'
DOCS_FILES.keep_predicate: every row an owner uploaded, and every row linked to a KEPT entity (driver, unit, customer, vendor, insurance, compliance)

ORPHANS._rule: ROUND 443.9 (owner 2026-10-10: 'there should be nothing from before' / 'delete anything related to the purge. Not any banking transactions'). A row here is deleted ONLY when the load / invoice / settlement / driver bill / fuel transaction / expense it points at no longer exists; a row whose parent still exists stays. Each predicate selects rows of `t` for company $1. Every table's orphan ids are snapshotted BEFORE any delete (a file is recognised by its dead links), then deleted in this order — links before files, checks before intakes. Executor: scripts/purge/purge-orphans-of-purged-documents.mts (lists each row in _system.purge_authorized_rows for the AUTH, deletes through accounting._purge_rows_cascade, which records audit.record_deletions). Guard: scripts/verify-no-orphan-of-purged-documents.mjs (every predicate counts 0). Banking is never in this list.

driver_finance.feed_intake_checks.parent: feed intake of a purged document
driver_finance.feed_intake_checks.where: t.operating_company_id = $1::uuid AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_finance.feed_intakes i WHERE i.id = t.intake_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_finance.feed_intakes i WHERE i.id = t.intake_id AND ((i.subject_table = 'accounting.invoices' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounting.invoices x WHERE x.id = i.subject_id)) OR (i.subject_table = 'mdata.loads' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mdata.loads x WHERE x.id = i.subject_id)) OR (i.subject_table = 'driver_finance.driver_settlements' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_finance.driver_settlements x WHERE x.id = i.subject_id)) OR (i.subject_table = 'driver_finance.driver_bills' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_finance.driver_bills x WHERE x.id = i.subject_id)) OR (i.subject_table = 'fuel.fuel_transactions' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fuel.fuel_transactions x WHERE x.id = i.subject_id)))))

driver_finance.feed_intakes.parent: invoice / load / settlement / driver bill / fuel transaction
driver_finance.feed_intakes.where: t.operating_company_id = $1::uuid AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_finance.feed_intakes i WHERE i.id = t.id AND ((i.subject_table = 'accounting.invoices' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounting.invoices x WHERE x.id = i.subject_id)) OR (i.subject_table = 'mdata.loads' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mdata.loads x WHERE x.id = i.subject_id)) OR (i.subject_table = 'driver_finance.driver_settlements' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_finance.driver_settlements x WHERE x.id = i.subject_id)) OR (i.subject_table = 'driver_finance.driver_bills' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_finance.driver_bills x WHERE x.id = i.subject_id)) OR (i.subject_table = 'fuel.fuel_transactions' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fuel.fuel_transactions x WHERE x.id = i.subject_id))))

reports.lane_profitability_cache.where: t.operating_company_id = $1::uuid AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mdata.loads l JOIN mdata.load_stops s ON s.load_id = l.id WHERE l.operating_company_id = t.operating_company_id AND upper(s.city) = upper(t.origin_city) AND upper(s.state) = upper(t.origin_state))

reports.deadhead_cache.where: t.operating_company_id = $1::uuid AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mdata.loads l WHERE l.operating_company_id = t.operating_company_id AND l.assigned_unit_id = t.unit_id)

pwa.driver_notifications.where: t.operating_company_id = $1::uuid AND jsonb_typeof(t.payload) = 'object' AND t.payload ? 'load_id' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mdata.loads l WHERE l.id::text = t.payload ->> 'load_id')

docs.file_links.parent: the linked load / settlement / invoice / bill / expense / fuel transaction
docs.file_links.scope: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM docs.files f WHERE f.id = t.file_id AND f.operating_company_id = $1::uuid)
docs.file_links.where: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM docs.files f WHERE f.id = t.file_id AND f.operating_company_id = $1::uuid) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM docs.file_links fl WHERE fl.id = t.id AND ((fl.entity_type = 'load' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mdata.loads x WHERE x.id = fl.entity_id)) OR (fl.entity_type = 'settlement' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_finance.driver_settlements x WHERE x.id = fl.entity_id)) OR (fl.entity_type = 'invoice' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounting.invoices x WHERE x.id = fl.entity_id)) OR (fl.entity_type = 'bill' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounting.bills x WHERE x.id = fl.entity_id)) OR (fl.entity_type = 'expense' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounting.expenses x WHERE x.id = fl.entity_id)) OR (fl.entity_type = 'fuel_transaction' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fuel.fuel_transactions x WHERE x.id = fl.entity_id))))

docs.files.parent: the purged load / settlement it was generated for: app-generated (dispatch_generated_at) artifacts whose every link points at a purged document. Owner uploads are evidence and are KEPT (DOCS_FILES rule); a file still linked to a live driver / customer / unit / contract stays.
docs.files.where: t.operating_company_id = $1::uuid AND t.dispatch_generated_at IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM docs.file_links fl WHERE fl.file_id = t.id AND ((fl.entity_type = 'load' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mdata.loads x WHERE x.id = fl.entity_id)) OR (fl.entity_type = 'settlement' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_finance.driver_settlements x WHERE x.id = fl.entity_id)) OR (fl.entity_type = 'invoice' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounting.invoices x WHERE x.id = fl.entity_id)) OR (fl.entity_type = 'bill' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounting.bills x WHERE x.id = fl.entity_id)) OR (fl.entity_type = 'expense' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounting.expenses x WHERE x.id = fl.entity_id)) OR (fl.entity_type = 'fuel_transaction' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fuel.fuel_transactions x WHERE x.id = fl.entity_id)))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM docs.file_links fl WHERE fl.file_id = t.id AND NOT ((fl.entity_type = 'load' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mdata.loads x WHERE x.id = fl.entity_id)) OR (fl.entity_type = 'settlement' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_finance.driver_settlements x WHERE x.id = fl.entity_id)) OR (fl.entity_type = 'invoice' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounting.invoices x WHERE x.id = fl.entity_id)) OR (fl.entity_type = 'bill' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounting.bills x WHERE x.id = fl.entity_id)) OR (fl.entity_type = 'expense' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounting.expenses x WHERE x.id = fl.entity_id)) OR (fl.entity_type = 'fuel_transaction' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fuel.fuel_transactions x WHERE x.id = fl.entity_id))))

safety.fuel_gps_matches.parent: bank transaction (fuel_txn_id -> banking.bank_transactions, KEPT) — measured 0 orphans; listed so a future purge can never strand one
safety.fuel_gps_matches.where: t.operating_company_id = $1::uuid AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM banking.bank_transactions b WHERE b.id = t.fuel_txn_id)

fuel.tank_events.where: t.operating_company_id = $1::uuid AND ((t.load_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mdata.loads l WHERE l.id = t.load_id)) OR (t.fuel_transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fuel.fuel_transactions f WHERE f.id = t.fuel_transaction_id)) OR (t.expense_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounting.expenses e WHERE e.id = t.expense_id)))

mdata.load_stops.where: t.operating_company_id = $1::uuid AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mdata.loads l WHERE l.id = t.load_id)
